header: A call to action beside its picture
lead: A two-column band. Editors choose which side the image goes on.
bodytext:
Text, one button, one plain link and the small print share one half. A single image fills the other. The switch only changes the visual order, so screen readers always read the text before the image.

On screens narrower than a tablet, the halves stack into one column. The image moves below the text and keeps its proportions.
caption: The caption belongs to the image and sits inside the figure.
note: The note is the small print under the buttons.

image.alternative: A woman in waders takes a water sample from a shallow river.
